<lead_handoff>Task: Visual QA homepage redesign

Visual QA for a static landing page. Do NOT edit the page file; only write scripts under /tmp/pw and report.

Page: /Users/wd/Documents/Deep Research Agent/homepage/deep-research-homepage.html (open via file:// URL, path has spaces → encode as %20).
Tooling: /tmp/pw has playwright-core installed. Launch with `chromium.launch({ channel: 'chrome' })` (the bundled headless shell is missing).

Write /tmp/pw/hp_qa.mjs that:
1. Viewport 1440x900, deviceScaleFactor 1. Collect console errors + pageerror.
2. For lang in ['zh','en']: goto URL + `?lang=${lang}`, wait 1500ms. Then scroll the whole page in steps of 300px with 120ms waits (so IntersectionObserver reveals fire), then back to top.
   - Screenshot viewport at top → /tmp/pw/qa_${lang}_hero.png
   - Scroll to the element `#scene` top and then to positions top + k*(scene.height - innerHeight)/5 + 50 for k = 0..4, wait 900ms each, screenshot viewport → /tmp/pw/qa_${lang}_scene${k}.png
   - For each selector `.manifesto`, `#proof`, `#ledger`, `#selfhost`, `#status`, `.finale`: scrollIntoView, wait 1800ms, screenshot viewport → /tmp/pw/qa_${lang}_<name>.png (name = selector without punctuation). For #proof also take extra screenshots after scrolling by 700px and 1400px further (qa_${lang}_proof2.png, proof3).
   - Full page screenshot → /tmp/pw/qa_${lang}_full.png
   - Assert: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth (report any overflow) and list elements whose getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth+1 (tag/class, max 15).
3. Viewport 390x844 (mobile), lang zh: same scroll pass, full-page screenshot /tmp/pw/qa_mobile_full.png plus overflow check.
4. Click test: on 1440 zh, click the first `[data-link="demo"]` and confirm `#toast` gets class `on`; click `.cite[data-seg="S13·1"]` and confirm `#preview-body` text contains "couple of years".
Print a concise JSON summary (errors, overflow results, click tests).

Run it with `cd /tmp/pw && node hp_qa.mjs`. Report: the full stdout and the list of generated png paths. Keep the report short.</lead_handoff>
